main_text.p: duni editionem urgeret. Ministros ri-tus Calviniani, statim atque hoc opus e-ditum acceperunt, Capello valde suc-censuisse, qvi Catholicis arma ministra-ret, suosqve ad autoritatem Ecclesiæ, ut aliqvid certi de scripturis haberent, re-currere cogeret, ita ut Libri censura Ca-pello gratissima futura sit, simulqve oc-casio cum suis in gratiam redeundi ; fu-sius in hac Epistola Morinus Capellum ejusqve criticam tuetur, docetqve, qvid utilitatis ex hoc opere in Ecclesiam Ca-tholicam redundet, & qvantum detri-menti Protestantibus afferat : fatetur qvidem, multa Capellum omisisse, qvæ vir Catholicus non reticuisset, verùm ni-hil omnino in hoc opere critico extare, qvod Religioni Catholicæ sit aperte con-trarium ; complures viros doctos, inter qvos Dionysius Petavius Jesuita, & Ma-rinus Mersennus è Minimorum familia, secum hujus libri editioni favisse. Addit nullum Doctorem Catholicum publice suffragio Librum istum probasse aut commendasse, autoris filium, qvi Ca-

page.notes: The "t" of "ut" in line 4 is printed as a raised superscript; transcribed as ut. Long s is printed as s throughout and has been normalised to s. Line-end hyphens are kept. The text ends on "Ca-", and "Catholi-" at the lower right is the catchword. Ink marks at the left edge and right margin are not text.
